mapper.select: SELECT device.tenant_id, organization.path AS organization_path FROM device JOIN organization ON organization.id = device.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = device.tenant_id WHERE device.id = #{deviceId} AND device.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT actual.id, actual.tenant_id, actual.device_id, actual.hardware_serial, actual.manufacturer, actual.firmware_version, actual.certificate_id, actual.connectivity_status, actual.last_seen_at, actual.commissioned_at, actual.version, actual.created_at, actual.updated_at, organization.path AS organization_path FROM device_actual actual JOIN device ON device.id = actual.device_id AND device.tenant_id = actual.tenant_id JOIN organization ON organization.id = device.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = device.tenant_id WHERE actual.device_id = #{deviceId}
